error.message: The agent harness runs fixture providers only.
error.name: EvlogError
error.why: This instance would start the machine's own Codex or Claude CLI, which spends turns on the owner's account.
error.fix: Point the instance at a fixture binary inside the harness fixture folder. Only the owner opts a run into real providers, with --real-providers.
